name: Rosewood Jeddah
positioning: City hotel on Jeddah's Corniche with sea and city views and interiors that blend modern style with Arabian design
best_for: Travelers who want Red Sea and city views from their room or suite
Guests interested in Jeddah's historic Al-Balad district

facts.text: Rooms and suites have sea and city views, with interiors that blend modernity with Arabian design.
Rooms have showers and Arabian artisan touches.
The suites have sea views and personalized service.
Habsburg, the all-day dining restaurant, serves breakfast spreads and international buffets.
Soleil is an elevated casual restaurant by the sea, serving from breakfast to sunset bites.
Soleil Rooftop combines views of the city skyline and the sea.
The Health Club offers a holistic self-care experience bringing together beauty, balance and healing.
The hotel has versatile spaces for meetings and events.

highlights.text: The Royal Suite occupies the two highest floors of the hotel, with views over the city and the Red Sea.
Habsburg, the all-day dining restaurant, looks out over the Corniche and the Red Sea.
Soleil Rooftop is an open-air venue for sunset gatherings, with weekend entertainment.
The hotel lists a Historic Al-Balad cultural experience, arranged on inquiry.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes limited beachfront access, as this is an urban setting.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
